name: B10-0443/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Attempts by the ruling party Georgian Dream to ban opposition parties in Georgia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on attempts by the ruling party Georgian Dream to ban opposition parties in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns moves by Georgia's ruling party, Georgian Dream, to ban major opposition parties through the Constitutional Court. It asks Georgia to drop laws that restrict political activity and peaceful protest. It calls on the European Union and its member states to sanction Bidzina Ivanishvili and other Georgian Dream leaders, including freezing his assets.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament only states its position and asks for action.
- It targets Georgia's government and Bidzina Ivanishvili, plus European Union member states.
- Next, the Council and member states decide whether to impose sanctions.
